0l2nsg8cs7s.text: His phone was never found. Neither was the van, or anyone who rode in it.
0l2nsg8cs7s.en: His phone was never found. Neither was the van, or anyone who rode in it.

1icuhpgre4u.speaker: Narrator
1icuhpgre4u.text: Tony Kwan resigns by text message and boards the evening flight to Colombo.
1icuhpgre4u.en: Tony Kwan resigns by text message and boards the evening flight to Colombo.

1u4ogrf9dja.speaker: Narrator
1u4ogrf9dja.text: Norhayati Salleh is transferred to Sandakan, at her own request.
1u4ogrf9dja.en: Norhayati Salleh is transferred to Sandakan, at her own request.

12vofuaciyl.speaker: Narrator
12vofuaciyl.text: Bay 3 has a new roof and new paint. The floor under the paint is still black.
12vofuaciyl.en: Bay 3 has a new roof and new paint. The floor under the paint is still black.

dir.say: [low, quiet] Bay 3 has a new roof and new paint. [break] [heavy] The floor under the paint is still black.

1qjoo41u05b.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1qjoo41u05b.text: One more thing from the port cameras. Tuesday, 2:41 AM, at this door. I cannot see his face.
1qjoo41u05b.en: One more thing from the port cameras. Tuesday, 2:41 AM, at this door. I cannot see his face.

0nsl44xhkcg.speaker: Narrator
0nsl44xhkcg.text: A man in a dark jacket, lighting a cigarette. The flame comes from a silver flip-top lighter.
0nsl44xhkcg.en: A man in a dark jacket, lighting a cigarette. The flame comes from a silver flip-top lighter.

dir.say: [low, slow, tense] A man in a dark jacket, lighting a cigarette. [break] The flame comes from a [emphasis] silver flip-top lighter.

0oyc3qtv9nc.speaker: Narrator
0oyc3qtv9nc.text: Your hand goes to your pocket. Daniel's lighter is still there. Of course it is.
0oyc3qtv9nc.en: Your hand goes to your pocket. Daniel's lighter is still there. Of course it is.

dir.say: [hushed] Your hand goes to your pocket. [break] Daniel's lighter is still there. [long-break] [shaken, whispering] Of course it is.

1ib45o1c9u6.speaker: Narrator
1ib45o1c9u6.text: The marine police boat finds the kelong at first light. A sampan is tied under it. A man is asleep on the planks with a phone held against his chest.
1ib45o1c9u6.en: The marine police boat finds the kelong at first light. A sampan is tied under it. A man is asleep on the planks with a phone held against his chest.

26u8q9qb4q6.speaker: Azman Yusof
26u8q9qb4q6.text: Saya buka pintu tu. Saya tak boleh tutup balik.
26u8q9qb4q6.en: I opened that door. I could not close it again.

184qo9v5wen.speaker: Narrator
184qo9v5wen.text: Amir reaches him first. He is holding the wooden triangle.
184qo9v5wen.en: Amir reaches him first. He is holding the wooden triangle.

1axl81w579g.speaker: Salmah
1axl81w579g.text: Terima kasih. Saya tak tahu nak cakap apa lagi.
1axl81w579g.en: Thank you. I do not know what else to say.

1j3qlgiahkn.speaker: Narrator
1j3qlgiahkn.text: On Azman's phone: forty-one photographs of the inside of Container 47. Farah finds the van in a Shah Alam cold store by noon. Twenty-three people. All of them alive.
1j3qlgiahkn.en: On Azman's phone: forty-one photographs of the inside of Container 47. Farah finds the van in a Shah Alam cold store by noon. Twenty-three people. All of them alive.

dir.say: [steady, quietly triumphant] On Azman's phone: forty-one photographs of the inside of Container 47. Farah finds the van in a Shah Alam cold store by noon. [break] Twenty-three people. [break] [moved] All of them [emphasis] alive.

0rh3xwgg8g8.speaker: Narrator
0rh3xwgg8g8.text: Tony Kwan is charged. He asks for a lawyer from Kuala Lumpur, and a lawyer from Singapore arrives instead, before lunch.
0rh3xwgg8g8.en: Tony Kwan is charged. He asks for a lawyer from Kuala Lumpur, and a lawyer from Singapore arrives instead, before lunch.

0zjt1ap7ejh.speaker: Narrator
0zjt1ap7ejh.text: Norhayati Salleh is charged. She removes her Customs badge herself and lays it on the table, face down.
0zjt1ap7ejh.en: Norhayati Salleh is charged. She removes her Customs badge herself and lays it on the table, face down.

1bsetz92i90.speaker: Narrator
1bsetz92i90.text: Faizal Ahmad is charged. He says nothing in the van. At the station he asks only whether anyone has told his sister.
1bsetz92i90.en: Faizal Ahmad is charged. He says nothing in the van. At the station he asks only whether anyone has told his sister.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Faizal Ahmad is charged. He says nothing in the van. [break] [softer, sorrowful] At the station he asks only whether anyone has told his sister.

1r8692v4cqq.speaker: Woman
1r8692v4cqq.text: Sorry. I am Jo. Jo Lim. Rachel Goh gave me your number. My grandfather made Dr. Goh's dentures for thirty years.
1r8692v4cqq.en: Sorry. I am Jo. Jo Lim. Rachel Goh gave me your number. My grandfather made Dr. Goh's dentures for thirty years.

dir.say: [sniffing, composing herself] Sorry. [break] I am Jo. Jo Lim. Rachel Goh gave me your number. [shaky] My grandfather made Dr. Goh's dentures for thirty years.

0warahb9qxt.speaker: Jo Lim
0warahb9qxt.text: Our shophouse in Penang burned at ten past four this morning. He was upstairs. Bomba says old wiring.
0warahb9qxt.en: Our shophouse in Penang burned at ten past four this morning. He was upstairs. Bomba says old wiring.

1xup23tq0c2.speaker: Jo Lim
1xup23tq0c2.text: He unplugged everything every night. Every night. The kettle, the radio, the lathe. He said electricity is a thief that comes in while you sleep.
1xup23tq0c2.en: He unplugged everything every night. Every night. The kettle, the radio, the lathe. He said electricity is a thief that comes in while you sleep.

dir.say: [insistent, grieving] He unplugged everything every night. [emphasis] Every night. The kettle, the radio, the lathe. [break] [fond, voice breaking] He said electricity is a thief that comes in while you sleep.

0sdby4haas3.speaker: Jo Lim
0sdby4haas3.text: Last week he said: if a detective comes asking about Dr. Goh, the moulds are in the back.
0sdby4haas3.en: Last week he said: if a detective comes asking about Dr. Goh, the moulds are in the back.

1eduldua9zv.speaker: Narrator
1eduldua9zv.text: The X-ray from Henry Goh's safe has been in your drawer since Mont Kiara, beside the paper kancil. PK-0821. Port Klang, August 2021.
1eduldua9zv.en: The X-ray from Henry Goh's safe has been in your drawer since Mont Kiara, beside the paper kancil. PK-0821. Port Klang, August 2021.

1am8g58vvf6.speaker: Narrator
1am8g58vvf6.text: A dentist read that X-ray, and a technician in Penang cast his models. One of them fell from Floor 14. The other died in the smoke above his own workshop.
1am8g58vvf6.en: A dentist read that X-ray, and a technician in Penang cast his models. One of them fell from Floor 14. The other died in the smoke above his own workshop.

dir.say: [low, slow, growing dread] A dentist read that X-ray, and a technician in Penang cast his models. [break] One of them fell from Floor 14. [break] The other died in the smoke above his own workshop.

0cod0nvm3u6.speaker: Narrator
0cod0nvm3u6.text: You put it in your inside pocket, next to Daniel's lighter.
0cod0nvm3u6.en: You put it in your inside pocket, next to Daniel's lighter.

1vhqnbcpeke.speaker: Bala Anne
1vhqnbcpeke.text: Penang-aa? Anga mazhai inga vida mosam.
1vhqnbcpeke.en: Penang? The rain there is worse than here.
1vhqnbcpeke.tts: பினாங்-ஆ? அங்க மழை இங்க விட மோசம்.

0pbivtwarc2.speaker: Narrator
0pbivtwarc2.text: He puts a three-tier tiffin carrier on the passenger seat and does not ask when you will be back.
0pbivtwarc2.en: He puts a three-tier tiffin carrier on the passenger seat and does not ask when you will be back.

1povkqqdo9j.speaker: Narrator
1povkqqdo9j.text: On the television over the counter, Dr. Shanti Menon's murder trial goes into its second week. Her lawyer tells the cameras the prosecution has a balcony, a print on a door handle, and no motive.
1povkqqdo9j.en: On the television over the counter, Dr. Shanti Menon's murder trial goes into its second week. Her lawyer tells the cameras the prosecution has a balcony, a print on a door handle, and no motive.

0rn0n88vvuk.speaker: Bala Anne
0rn0n88vvuk.text: That durian man Ravi came to eat yesterday. He paid for his own teh. He looked at your stairs a long time.
0rn0n88vvuk.en: That durian man Ravi came to eat yesterday. He paid for his own teh. He looked at your stairs a long time.

2a7qvwx1r5j.speaker: Narrator
2a7qvwx1r5j.text: A message from Salmah, the first in weeks: a photo of Faizal's lorry with a repossession notice under the wiper. No words.
2a7qvwx1r5j.en: A message from Salmah, the first in weeks: a photo of Faizal's lorry with a repossession notice under the wiper. No words.

1zq6x182dmq.speaker: Narrator
1zq6x182dmq.text: Thirteen and a half kilometres of bridge, and the rain comes across the strait sideways.
1zq6x182dmq.en: Thirteen and a half kilometres of bridge, and the rain comes across the strait sideways.

0sdnd42fj3s.speaker: Narrator
0sdnd42fj3s.text: Since Ipoh, a grey sedan has held four cars behind you. WXY 1408. It takes the bridge with you and does not overtake. On the island it turns off at Jelutong, and is back in your mirror by Lebuh Pantai.
0sdnd42fj3s.en: Since Ipoh, a grey sedan has held four cars behind you. WXY 1408. It takes the bridge with you and does not overtake. On the island it turns off at Jelutong, and is back in your mirror by Lebuh Pantai.

1ubwnvagtuh.speaker: Narrator
1ubwnvagtuh.text: George Town comes up out of the rain in clan-house roofs and hotel cranes, the old and the new leaning on each other.
1ubwnvagtuh.en: George Town comes up out of the rain in clan-house roofs and hotel cranes, the old and the new leaning on each other.

08esqun2yf3.speaker: Narrator
08esqun2yf3.text: No. 96 is a black mouth in a row of pastel shophouses. The five-foot way is wet with hose water, and the air tastes of plaster and burnt wax.
08esqun2yf3.en: No. 96 is a black mouth in a row of pastel shophouses. The five-foot way is wet with hose water, and the air tastes of plaster and burnt wax.

0evmz4rjt1g.speaker: Narrator
0evmz4rjt1g.text: On one side, the joss-paper and coffin shop at No. 94, shutters half down. On the other, a hoarding printed with a hotel that does not exist yet. THE CHULIA. A Sinar Heritage Hotel.
0evmz4rjt1g.en: On one side, the joss-paper and coffin shop at No. 94, shutters half down. On the other, a hoarding printed with a hotel that does not exist yet. THE CHULIA. A Sinar Heritage Hotel.

dir.say: [observant, measured] On one side, the joss-paper and coffin shop at No. 94, shutters half down. On the other, a hoarding printed with a hotel that does not exist yet. [break] [dry] The Chulia. A [emphasis] Sinar Heritage Hotel.
[cold realization] Sinar. [break] [quiet] You read it twice.

226syswxvku.speaker: Jo Lim
226syswxvku.text: He had been sleeping at my flat since he fell in September. On Wednesday he went home. He said somebody had to be there, in case the detective came.
226syswxvku.en: He had been sleeping at my flat since he fell in September. On Wednesday he went home. He said somebody had to be there, in case the detective came.

0omrp6kp70w.speaker: Jo Lim
0omrp6kp70w.text: You are one day late. I am not saying it to be cruel. I am just saying it.
0omrp6kp70w.en: You are one day late. I am not saying it to be cruel. I am just saying it.

dir.say: [quiet, raw] You are one day late. [break] [tired, honest] I am not saying it to be cruel. I am just saying it.

0sj7fhd1oqh.speaker: Narrator
0sj7fhd1oqh.text: His reading glasses are in her shirt pocket. He left them on her bedside table, and meant to come back for them.
0sj7fhd1oqh.en: His reading glasses are in her shirt pocket. He left them on her bedside table, and meant to come back for them.

1ofrw4y6bx5.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1ofrw4y6bx5.text: Penang is not mine either. With you that is becoming a habit.
1ofrw4y6bx5.en: Penang is not mine either. With you that is becoming a habit.

0dd9ek5np0t.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0dd9ek5np0t.text: Azman sends his salam. He gave me his photos from the port. One is a reefer van backing into Bay 3, with a small sunburst on the door. Sinar Cold Chain. I am sending it to you.
0dd9ek5np0t.en: Azman sends his salam. He gave me his photos from the port. One is a reefer van backing into Bay 3, with a small sunburst on the door. Sinar Cold Chain. I am sending it to you.

dir.say: [warmer] Azman sends his salam. [break] [businesslike] He gave me his photos from the port. One is a reefer van backing into Bay 3, with a small sunburst on the door. [pointed] Sinar Cold Chain. I am sending it to you.

1r4j05wjzso.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1r4j05wjzso.text: Tulis semua. Hantar pada saya setiap malam.
1r4j05wjzso.en: Write everything down. Send it to me every night. I am not losing another witness.

15pdnww3owt.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
15pdnww3owt.text: Something you will enjoy. Kawalan Sentosa has a new regional supervisor in Penang. Rizal Hamdan. He has done well for a man who deleted seventeen minutes.
15pdnww3owt.en: Something you will enjoy. Kawalan Sentosa has a new regional supervisor in Penang. Rizal Hamdan. He has done well for a man who deleted seventeen minutes.

dir.say: [sardonic] Something you will enjoy. [break] Kawalan Sentosa has a new regional supervisor in Penang. Rizal Hamdan. [cold, contemptuous] He has done well for a man who deleted seventeen minutes.

08jlreshhli.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
08jlreshhli.text: Call me when you have something I can write down.
08jlreshhli.en: Call me when you have something I can write down.

0rmg9mhztdm.speaker: Narrator
0rmg9mhztdm.text: Your phone buzzes on the pillow. WhatsApp, from a +94 number. Sri Lanka.
0rmg9mhztdm.en: Your phone buzzes on the pillow. WhatsApp, from a +94 number. Sri Lanka.

0b64zahfxy3.speaker: Narrator
0b64zahfxy3.text: No text. One photograph: Colombo port at night, the cranes lit orange, taken from the deck of a ship.
0b64zahfxy3.en: No text. One photograph: Colombo port at night, the cranes lit orange, taken from the deck of a ship.

14q37exkrwk.speaker: Narrator
14q37exkrwk.text: You do not reply. You do not delete it either.
14q37exkrwk.en: You do not reply. You do not delete it either.

0yvs59po1yr.speaker: Narrator
0yvs59po1yr.text: Bomba amends its report before lunch. Deliberate ignition at the rear of the premises. The words "old wiring" are taken out.
0yvs59po1yr.en: Bomba amends its report before lunch. Deliberate ignition at the rear of the premises. The words "old wiring" are taken out.

1old4iluomg.speaker: Jo Lim
1old4iluomg.text: They say it is finished. It does not feel finished.
1old4iluomg.en: They say it is finished. It does not feel finished.

16gs2i2moyw.speaker: Narrator
16gs2i2moyw.text: Kenny's half of No. 96 goes to his creditors. His creditors sell it to Sinar Heritage within the month.
16gs2i2moyw.en: Kenny's half of No. 96 goes to his creditors. His creditors sell it to Sinar Heritage within the month.

19eotryz7t9.speaker: Narrator
19eotryz7t9.text: The shutters of No. 94 stay down. A leasing agent from Gurney Drive pins a card to them.
19eotryz7t9.en: The shutters of No. 94 stay down. A leasing agent from Gurney Drive pins a card to them.

0n8dwutj2mn.speaker: Narrator
0n8dwutj2mn.text: A Sinar Heritage envelope arrives for the estate: a condolence card and a better offer. Jo leaves both on her drawing board, unopened. By Friday the hoarding has been moved, so that it wraps around No. 96 on both sides.
0n8dwutj2mn.en: A Sinar Heritage envelope arrives for the estate: a condolence card and a better offer. Jo leaves both on her drawing board, unopened. By Friday the hoarding has been moved, so that it wraps around No. 96 on both sides.

0jodjd1rmug.speaker: Narrator
0jodjd1rmug.text: The hoarding stays where it is. Work on The Chulia is suspended "pending a review". Nobody from Sinar Heritage comes to Uncle Lim's funeral.
0jodjd1rmug.en: The hoarding stays where it is. Work on The Chulia is suspended "pending a review". Nobody from Sinar Heritage comes to Uncle Lim's funeral.

25bqq6gcp4g.speaker: Narrator
25bqq6gcp4g.text: In the project folder, one more scan Jo had not opened: a customs clearance for The Chulia's imported "fittings", forty crates, stamped in Sandakan. Officer: N. SALLEH.
25bqq6gcp4g.en: In the project folder, one more scan Jo had not opened: a customs clearance for The Chulia's imported "fittings", forty crates, stamped in Sandakan. Officer: N. SALLEH.

dir.say: [low, ominous] In the project folder, one more scan Jo had not opened: a customs clearance for The Chulia's imported "fittings", forty crates, stamped in Sandakan. [break] Officer: [emphasis] N. Salleh.

0yw86nkg6f5.speaker: Narrator
0yw86nkg6f5.text: At dawn the hotel site's skip is lifted onto a lorry and driven across the bridge.
0yw86nkg6f5.en: At dawn the hotel site's skip is lifted onto a lorry and driven across the bridge.

20phnshot2w.speaker: Narrator
20phnshot2w.text: Whatever was in Uncle Lim's carton went with it, or went somewhere else first. Nobody will ever say which.
20phnshot2w.en: Whatever was in Uncle Lim's carton went with it, or went somewhere else first. Nobody will ever say which.

0k8hop2p7qm.speaker: Narrator
0k8hop2p7qm.text: Rizal Hamdan transfers Shahrul Nizam to a site in Johor Bahru, with a week's notice and a good reference.
0k8hop2p7qm.en: Rizal Hamdan transfers Shahrul Nizam to a site in Johor Bahru, with a week's notice and a good reference.

06tfzpe927h.speaker: Narrator
06tfzpe927h.text: The X-ray goes back in your drawer. The 2021 file says what it has always said.
06tfzpe927h.en: The X-ray goes back in your drawer. The 2021 file says what it has always said.

02vw4bhleyy.speaker: Narrator
02vw4bhleyy.text: Farah files your answer. It changes nothing. It was already the answer.
02vw4bhleyy.en: Farah files your answer. It changes nothing. It was already the answer.

1fen05gipth.speaker: Narrator
1fen05gipth.text: At closing, Madam Ong wipes the same table and sets out two glasses of teh. One for her. One for whoever comes.
1fen05gipth.en: At closing, Madam Ong wipes the same table and sets out two glasses of teh. One for her. One for whoever comes.

0riujtri0y5.speaker: Narrator
0riujtri0y5.text: The poster stays on the noticeboard for another monsoon.
0riujtri0y5.en: The poster stays on the noticeboard for another monsoon.

29titt60elr.speaker: Narrator
29titt60elr.text: Under your office door, on the mat: a paper kancil.
29titt60elr.en: Under your office door, on the mat: a paper kancil.

1vx1orhiwmi.speaker: Narrator
1vx1orhiwmi.text: It is folded from a Penang ferry ticket. Butterworth to George Town, one adult, dated the morning you left.
1vx1orhiwmi.en: It is folded from a Penang ferry ticket. Butterworth to George Town, one adult, dated the morning you left.

251qhjrmb3l.speaker: Narrator
251qhjrmb3l.text: The coroner's court amends a 2021 finding in eleven minutes. Henry Goh's certificate is struck out. Uncle Lim's order book is entered in its place.
251qhjrmb3l.en: The coroner's court amends a 2021 finding in eleven minutes. Henry Goh's certificate is struck out. Uncle Lim's order book is entered in its place.

1cmpxo0uo2c.speaker: Narrator
1cmpxo0uo2c.text: At Cheras, the grave with Daniel's name on it is opened at dawn. You stand at the back. Farah stands beside you and says nothing, which is the kindest thing she has ever done for you.
1cmpxo0uo2c.en: At Cheras, the grave with Daniel's name on it is opened at dawn. You stand at the back. Farah stands beside you and says nothing, which is the kindest thing she has ever done for you.

06vsunld5iu.speaker: Narrator
06vsunld5iu.text: Ong Wei Jie crosses to Butterworth on the morning ferry, the way he crossed to work for eight years.
06vsunld5iu.en: Ong Wei Jie crosses to Butterworth on the morning ferry, the way he crossed to work for eight years.

1g17eameapu.speaker: Madam Ong
1g17eameapu.text: Wa e kiann tng lai liao.

1km6iscup45.speaker: Narrator
1km6iscup45.text: At closing she sets out one glass of teh, not two.
1km6iscup45.en: At closing she sets out one glass of teh, not two.

1ijw5ukx2a1.speaker: Narrator
1ijw5ukx2a1.text: In Cheras there is now a grave with Daniel's name on it and nobody in it. Nobody asks you what that means. You do not ask yourself.
1ijw5ukx2a1.en: In Cheras there is now a grave with Daniel's name on it and nobody in it. Nobody asks you what that means. You do not ask yourself.

16zlxoz3s3a.speaker: Narrator
16zlxoz3s3a.text: Farah writes "possibly an unidentified foreign national" in the margin of a closed file. Nobody reads margins.
16zlxoz3s3a.en: Farah writes "possibly an unidentified foreign national" in the margin of a closed file. Nobody reads margins.

290pem94hq8.speaker: Narrator
290pem94hq8.text: Farah asks who would forge an X-ray of a jaw that was never there, and then cast it in plaster. You do not have an answer.
290pem94hq8.en: Farah asks who would forge an X-ray of a jaw that was never there, and then cast it in plaster. You do not have an answer.

0a2exp2tkaw.speaker: Narrator
0a2exp2tkaw.text: Kenny Lim is charged with arson and culpable homicide. He tells the magistrate he was in Air Itam losing three thousand four hundred ringgit. Nobody at the den will say so on paper.
0a2exp2tkaw.en: Kenny Lim is charged with arson and culpable homicide. He tells the magistrate he was in Air Itam losing three thousand four hundred ringgit. Nobody at the den will say so on paper.

0sxmedultyn.speaker: Jo Lim
0sxmedultyn.text: They took Kenny. He used to carry me on his shoulders down Lebuh Chulia at Chap Goh Meh. I keep waiting to feel something more than tired.
0sxmedultyn.en: They took Kenny. He used to carry me on his shoulders down Lebuh Chulia at Chap Goh Meh. I keep waiting to feel something more than tired.

dir.say: [numb, bitter] They took Kenny. [break] [wistful, voice breaking] He used to carry me on his shoulders down Lebuh Chulia at Chap Goh Meh. [break] [exhausted] I keep waiting to feel something more than tired.

01zstlbjyoq.speaker: Narrator
01zstlbjyoq.text: Cheah Siew Lan is charged with arson. She closes No. 94 for the first time in thirty-one years. Her paper houses sit unsold in the window, fading in the sun.
01zstlbjyoq.en: Cheah Siew Lan is charged with arson. She closes No. 94 for the first time in thirty-one years. Her paper houses sit unsold in the window, fading in the sun.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Cheah Siew Lan is charged with arson. [break] [melancholy] She closes No. 94 for the first time in thirty-one years. Her paper houses sit unsold in the window, fading in the sun.

2523x2mh7ph.speaker: Jo Lim
2523x2mh7ph.text: Auntie Cheah gave Ah Kong a discount on a coffin in 2015, as a joke, when he turned sixty-five. They laughed for a week. That was before the wall.
2523x2mh7ph.en: Auntie Cheah gave Ah Kong a discount on a coffin in 2015, as a joke, when he turned sixty-five. They laughed for a week. That was before the wall.

dir.say: [fond, faintly amused] Auntie Cheah gave Ah Kong a discount on a coffin in 2015, as a joke, when he turned sixty-five. They laughed for a week. [break] [sad, quiet] That was before the wall.

1f122kgwk9u.speaker: Narrator
1f122kgwk9u.text: Melissa Ong is charged with abetting arson and culpable homicide. Sinar Heritage issues a statement before she reaches the lock-up: she acted alone, and has been dismissed.
1f122kgwk9u.en: Melissa Ong is charged with abetting arson and culpable homicide. Sinar Heritage issues a statement before she reaches the lock-up: she acted alone, and has been dismissed.

1a6r1y4rj08.speaker: Narrator
1a6r1y4rj08.text: Shahrul Nizam is charged with arson and culpable homicide. In the van he asks, in the soft Malay of Kedah, whether the old man suffered. "Orang tua tu tak patut ada kat situ." The old man was not supposed to be there.
1a6r1y4rj08.en: Shahrul Nizam is charged with arson and culpable homicide. In the van he asks, in the soft Malay of Kedah, whether the old man suffered. "Orang tua tu tak patut ada kat situ." The old man was not supposed to be there.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Shahrul Nizam is charged with arson and culpable homicide. [softer, troubled] In the van he asks, in the soft Malay of Kedah, whether the old man suffered. [whispering] "Orang tua tu tak patut ada kat situ." [break] The old man was not supposed to be there.

0yvud35lzkv.speaker: Narrator
0yvud35lzkv.text: Under the bed in Shahrul's rented room: a carton marked GOH 2021 in Uncle Lim's capitals. Fourteen plaster jaws, each wrapped in a page of the Kwong Wah Yit Poh.
0yvud35lzkv.en: Under the bed in Shahrul's rented room: a carton marked GOH 2021 in Uncle Lim's capitals. Fourteen plaster jaws, each wrapped in a page of the Kwong Wah Yit Poh.

21ezqsvf9j8.speaker: Narrator
21ezqsvf9j8.text: He was told a man would collect it at the ferry terminal on Monday morning. Nobody came. Somebody heard about the arrests first.
21ezqsvf9j8.en: He was told a man would collect it at the ferry terminal on Monday morning. Nobody came. Somebody heard about the arrests first.

1rxwwq57e4z.speaker: Narrator
1rxwwq57e4z.text: Farah drives it to Kuala Lumpur herself, the carton on the passenger seat with the seatbelt across it.
1rxwwq57e4z.en: Farah drives it to Kuala Lumpur herself, the carton on the passenger seat with the seatbelt across it.

0ce9qsy1x2h.speaker: Jo Lim
0ce9qsy1x2h.text: He unplugged everything. Every night. Now somebody has written it down.
0ce9qsy1x2h.en: He unplugged everything. Every night. Now somebody has written it down.

dir.say: [tearful, grateful] He unplugged everything. [break] Every night. [break] [quiet pride] Now somebody has written it down.

2bx4lr1vlfs.speaker: Bala Anne
2bx4lr1vlfs.text: Thambi, unakku oru parcel vandhirukku. Colombo-la irundhu.
2bx4lr1vlfs.en: Boy, a parcel came for you. From Colombo.
2bx4lr1vlfs.tts: தம்பி, உனக்கு ஒரு பார்சல் வந்திருக்கு. கொழும்புல இருந்து.

dir.say: [warm, curious, a little wary] தம்பி, உனக்கு ஒரு பார்சல் வந்திருக்கு. [break] கொழும்புல இருந்து.

17uhvs750dr.speaker: Bala Anne
17uhvs750dr.text: No name on the back. I kept it under the till for three days. It felt too small to be anything good.
17uhvs750dr.en: No name on the back. I kept it under the till for three days. It felt too small to be anything good.

dir.say: [gruff, uneasy] No name on the back. I kept it under the till for three days. [break] [low, superstitious] It felt too small to be anything good.

0fwru3dkjvl.speaker: Narrator
0fwru3dkjvl.text: On the television over the counter, the verdict in Dr. Shanti Menon's trial is due on Friday. Bala Anne turns the sound down without being asked.
0fwru3dkjvl.en: On the television over the counter, the verdict in Dr. Shanti Menon's trial is due on Friday. Bala Anne turns the sound down without being asked.

0ms9k4bvsoe.speaker: Bala Anne
0ms9k4bvsoe.text: That durian man Ravi came again. He asked if you were well. I told him you are never well.
0ms9k4bvsoe.en: That durian man Ravi came again. He asked if you were well. I told him you are never well.

dir.say: [conspiratorial, low] That durian man Ravi came again. He asked if you were well. [break] [dry, affectionate] I told him you are never well.

0fvkmh9tcvo.speaker: Narrator
0fvkmh9tcvo.text: A message from Jo Lim, the first since Penang: Kenny's trial is set for March. Nothing else.
0fvkmh9tcvo.en: A message from Jo Lim, the first since Penang: Kenny's trial is set for March. Nothing else.

0yk4xbsrrzb.speaker: Narrator
0yk4xbsrrzb.text: Inside, in a fold of white gem paper: one uncut blue sapphire, the size of a fingertip. Rough and cloudy, and blue all the way down.
0yk4xbsrrzb.en: Inside, in a fold of white gem paper: one uncut blue sapphire, the size of a fingertip. Rough and cloudy, and blue all the way down.

dir.say: [hushed, intimate] Inside, in a fold of white gem paper: one uncut blue sapphire, the size of a fingertip. [break] [quietly awed] Rough and cloudy, and blue all the way down.

06v16eoop8u.speaker: Narrator
06v16eoop8u.text: Around it, a mamak receipt folded into a kancil. You know the paper before you open it. Restoran Bala, Brickfields. Two teh tarik, table 6, by the stairs. August 2021, the week before the fire.
06v16eoop8u.en: Around it, a mamak receipt folded into a kancil. You know the paper before you open it. Restoran Bala, Brickfields. Two teh tarik, table 6, by the stairs. August 2021, the week before the fire.

dir.say: [low, slow, recognition dawning] Around it, a mamak receipt folded into a kancil. You know the paper before you open it. [break] Restoran Bala, Brickfields. Two teh tarik, table 6, by the stairs. [long-break] [aching, quiet] August 2021, the week before the fire.

0ln7zxqzyy9.speaker: Narrator
0ln7zxqzyy9.text: On the gem paper, a rubber stamp in Tamil and English. Yogeswaran Gem House, 112 Sea Street, Colombo 11. A telephone number.
0ln7zxqzyy9.en: On the gem paper, a rubber stamp in Tamil and English. Yogeswaran Gem House, 112 Sea Street, Colombo 11. A telephone number.

dir.say: [crying, numb with shock] அப்பா போயிட்டார்.

17vqjunn7gl.speaker: Woman
17vqjunn7gl.text: Sorry. You are calling from Malaysia? I am Tharshini. Yogeswaran is my father. Was my father.
17vqjunn7gl.en: Sorry. You are calling from Malaysia? I am Tharshini. Yogeswaran is my father. Was my father.

dir.say: [sniffing, composing herself] Sorry. You are calling from Malaysia? [break] I am Tharshini. Yogeswaran is my father. [long-break] [voice breaking] Was my father.

28s1ypf664u.speaker: Tharshini Yogeswaran
28s1ypf664u.text: They found him in Beira Lake this morning. The police say he drank arrack and fell in.
28s1ypf664u.en: They found him in Beira Lake this morning. The police say he drank arrack and fell in.

09rnjql0t52.speaker: Tharshini Yogeswaran
09rnjql0t52.text: Appa did not drink. And he could not swim, so he never went near the water after dark. Never.
09rnjql0t52.en: Appa did not drink. And he could not swim, so he never went near the water after dark. Never.

dir.say: [insistent, grieving] Appa did not drink. [break] And he could not swim, so he never went near the water after dark. [emphasis] Never.

0yu16qrd0r3.speaker: You
0yu16qrd0r3.text: Did he ever talk about a Malaysian?
0yu16qrd0r3.en: Did he ever talk about a Malaysian?

2apuzr12q97.speaker: Tharshini Yogeswaran
2apuzr12q97.text: Last week. He said a Malaysian had come to help him undo what he had done. He said it like a prayer.
2apuzr12q97.en: Last week. He said a Malaysian had come to help him undo what he had done. He said it like a prayer.

dir.say: [quiet, remembering] Last week. He said a Malaysian had come to help him undo what he had done. [break] [soft, wondering, sad] He said it like a prayer.

0kujysicy9b.speaker: Narrator
0kujysicy9b.text: The monsoon got to Colombo before you did. It comes off the Indian Ocean in sheets, and the tuk-tuk takes it side-on.
0kujysicy9b.en: The monsoon got to Colombo before you did. It comes off the Indian Ocean in sheets, and the tuk-tuk takes it side-on.

0l79iniz39w.speaker: Narrator
0l79iniz39w.text: At Katunayake, among the drivers holding names at arrivals, one card says only J. The man holding it is looking at you. When you look back, he folds it in half and walks away.
0l79iniz39w.en: At Katunayake, among the drivers holding names at arrivals, one card says only J. The man holding it is looking at you. When you look back, he folds it in half and walks away.

dir.say: [tense, watchful, low] At Katunayake, among the drivers holding names at arrivals, one card says only J. [break] The man holding it is looking at you. [break] [cold, uneasy] When you look back, he folds it in half and walks away.
[cheerful, shouting over the rain] මල්ලි, කොහෙද යන්නේ?

13ro368dar3.speaker: Tuk-tuk driver
13ro368dar3.text: Sea Street! Gold street. Rain is no problem, sir. In Colombo the rain is free.
13ro368dar3.en: Sea Street! Gold street. Rain is no problem, sir. In Colombo the rain is free.

dir.say: [delighted, chatty] Sea Street! Gold street. [break] [laughing] Rain is no problem, sir. In Colombo the rain is free.

24jg9wvc15e.speaker: Narrator
24jg9wvc15e.text: Sea Street smells of jasmine, diesel and hot oil. Every shopfront is a lit glass counter full of gold, and every shopkeeper is watching the one in the middle, where the shutter is half down and a white cloth is tied over the door.
24jg9wvc15e.en: Sea Street smells of jasmine, diesel and hot oil. Every shopfront is a lit glass counter full of gold, and every shopkeeper is watching the one in the middle, where the shutter is half down and a white cloth is tied over the door.

0ub50sw57pl.speaker: Narrator
0ub50sw57pl.text: Round the corner a kottu stall chops roti on the griddle, two steel blades going like a train over points. It does not stop for the rain. It does not stop for anything.
0ub50sw57pl.en: Round the corner a kottu stall chops roti on the griddle, two steel blades going like a train over points. It does not stop for the rain. It does not stop for anything.

dir.say: [atmospheric, quietly admiring] Round the corner a kottu stall chops roti on the griddle, two steel blades going like a train over points. [break] [dry] It does not stop for the rain. [low] It does not stop for anything.

16gvy624jws.speaker: Tharshini Yogeswaran
16gvy624jws.text: He sat at that bench for thirty-eight years. He could tell you where a stone was born just by holding it to the window.
16gvy624jws.en: He sat at that bench for thirty-eight years. He could tell you where a stone was born just by holding it to the window.

dir.say: [fond, grieving] He sat at that bench for thirty-eight years. [break] [proud, voice catching] He could tell you where a stone was born just by holding it to the window.

229a7wq1kt3.speaker: Tharshini Yogeswaran
229a7wq1kt3.text: Six years ago he started coming home late, and quiet. Last month he started sleeping again. Then this.
229a7wq1kt3.en: Six years ago he started coming home late, and quiet. Last month he started sleeping again. Then this.

dir.say: [quiet, troubled] Six years ago he started coming home late, and quiet. [break] [softer] Last month he started sleeping again. [long-break] [bitter, breaking] Then this.

113orfib4g5.speaker: Narrator
113orfib4g5.text: His loupe hangs on a cord around her neck. She has not taken it off since the morning they found him.
113orfib4g5.en: His loupe hangs on a cord around her neck. She has not taken it off since the morning they found him.

1oa3ut5cqsj.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
1oa3ut5cqsj.text: Inspector Iskandar telephoned me. She said you would come whether I liked it or not.
1oa3ut5cqsj.en: Inspector Iskandar telephoned me. She said you would come whether I liked it or not.

0wwm9fg7jin.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
0wwm9fg7jin.text: The file at Slave Island station says an old man drank and slipped. I have asked for it. They were surprised anybody wanted it.
0wwm9fg7jin.en: The file at Slave Island station says an old man drank and slipped. I have asked for it. They were surprised anybody wanted it.

dir.say: [measured, weary] The file at Slave Island station says an old man drank and slipped. [break] I have asked for it. [dry, sardonic] They were surprised anybody wanted it.

1376a3chgqf.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
1376a3chgqf.text: She also asked me to check one name. A Malaysian, Tony Kwan, came on a work visa in the spring. Sinar Cold Chain Lanka. He runs their reefer depot at Bloemendhal, by the port.
1376a3chgqf.en: She also asked me to check one name. A Malaysian, Tony Kwan, came on a work visa in the spring. Sinar Cold Chain Lanka. He runs their reefer depot at Bloemendhal, by the port.

dir.say: [businesslike, lower] She also asked me to check one name. A Malaysian, Tony Kwan, came on a work visa in the spring. [break] [pointed] Sinar Cold Chain Lanka. He runs their reefer depot at Bloemendhal, by the port.

1khbpvojr6f.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
1khbpvojr6f.text: And she sent a photograph from a crane driver in Port Klang. A reefer unit going into Bay 3 in 2021, serial RU-11. She thinks I will find it here.
1khbpvojr6f.en: And she sent a photograph from a crane driver in Port Klang. A reefer unit going into Bay 3 in 2021, serial RU-11. She thinks I will find it here.

dir.say: [thoughtful, measured] And she sent a photograph from a crane driver in Port Klang. A reefer unit going into Bay 3 in 2021, serial R U eleven. [break] [quiet, grim] She thinks I will find it here.
[calm, resolved, quiet] හරි. [break] අපි බලමු.

2dqj1hxolu9.speaker: Narrator
2dqj1hxolu9.text: Slave Island station amends its file on the morning of the cremation. Not misadventure. Drowning, by another hand.
2dqj1hxolu9.en: Slave Island station amends its file on the morning of the cremation. Not misadventure. Drowning, by another hand.

dir.say: [measured, sober] Slave Island station amends its file on the morning of the cremation. [break] Not misadventure. [quiet, grave] Drowning, by another hand.

0qdy1y9x5tj.speaker: Tharshini Yogeswaran
0qdy1y9x5tj.text: They say it is finished. Appa would have held it to the light a little longer.
0qdy1y9x5tj.en: They say it is finished. Appa would have held it to the light a little longer.

dir.say: [hollow, tired] They say it is finished. [break] [sad, wistful] Appa would have held it to the light a little longer.

0e5pymow31p.speaker: Narrator
0e5pymow31p.text: Mohan's half of 112 Sea Street goes to his lender, and his lender sells it to Sinar Gems Lanka before the month is out.
0e5pymow31p.en: Mohan's half of 112 Sea Street goes to his lender, and his lender sells it to Sinar Gems Lanka before the month is out.

1jhubayqfby.speaker: Narrator
1jhubayqfby.text: Shehani Gunasekera flies to Singapore on Saturday "for a conference". The Port City showroom does not open again. Within a week a new name is painted on the director's door: Melissa Ong.
1jhubayqfby.en: Shehani Gunasekera flies to Singapore on Saturday "for a conference". The Port City showroom does not open again. Within a week a new name is painted on the director's door: Melissa Ong.

dir.say: [dry, sardonic] Shehani Gunasekera flies to Singapore on Saturday "for a conference". The Port City showroom does not open again. [break] [low, ominous] Within a week a new name is painted on the director's door: [emphasis] Melissa Ong.

1nskh21cnzv.speaker: Narrator
1nskh21cnzv.text: Shehani Gunasekera flies to Singapore on Saturday "for a conference". The Port City showroom does not open again.
1nskh21cnzv.en: Shehani Gunasekera flies to Singapore on Saturday "for a conference". The Port City showroom does not open again.

0jqj73dt4g3.speaker: Narrator
0jqj73dt4g3.text: Kasun Ranaweera signs on as a reefer technician aboard a Sinar Cold Chain feeder ship. Its next port of call is Port Klang.
0jqj73dt4g3.en: Kasun Ranaweera signs on as a reefer technician aboard a Sinar Cold Chain feeder ship. Its next port of call is Port Klang.

dir.say: [flat, bitter] Kasun Ranaweera signs on as a reefer technician aboard a Sinar Cold Chain feeder ship. [break] [low, ominous] Its next port of call is Port Klang.

0zk3fpsbeix.speaker: Narrator
0zk3fpsbeix.text: Tony Kwan is not at the depot on Friday. His desk is clear, and his second phone has gone with him.
0zk3fpsbeix.en: Tony Kwan is not at the depot on Friday. His desk is clear, and his second phone has gone with him.

197mj5qrcwi.speaker: Narrator
197mj5qrcwi.text: CID open the safe at 112 Sea Street with Mohan's key. It holds the shop's gold, a bundle of school reports with Tharshini's name on them, and nothing else.
197mj5qrcwi.en: CID open the safe at 112 Sea Street with Mohan's key. It holds the shop's gold, a bundle of school reports with Tharshini's name on them, and nothing else.

dir.say: [flat, matter-of-fact] CID open the safe at 112 Sea Street with Mohan's key. [break] [softer, rueful] It holds the shop's gold, a bundle of school reports with Tharshini's name on them, and nothing else.

1oaxw6c11j9.speaker: Narrator
1oaxw6c11j9.text: On Friday evening Herath reads the mortuary's effects list again, and finds the line everybody skipped. One pink ticket, no. 0414. Found in left sock.
1oaxw6c11j9.en: On Friday evening Herath reads the mortuary's effects list again, and finds the line everybody skipped. One pink ticket, no. 0414. Found in left sock.

dir.say: [low, slow realization] On Friday evening Herath reads the mortuary's effects list again, and finds the line everybody skipped. [break] One pink ticket, number oh four one four. [quiet] Found in left sock.

0tn22nd496m.speaker: Narrator
0tn22nd496m.text: The cloakroom clerk remembers 0414. It was collected on Thursday morning by a man in a work polo with a little sun on the pocket. He had the ticket. He paid for the three days.
0tn22nd496m.en: The cloakroom clerk remembers 0414. It was collected on Thursday morning by a man in a work polo with a little sun on the pocket. He had the ticket. He paid for the three days.

dir.say: [low, bitter] The cloakroom clerk remembers oh four one four. It was collected on Thursday morning by a man in a work polo with a little sun on the pocket. [break] [cold] He had the ticket. He paid for the three days.

15xye15jh8k.speaker: Narrator
15xye15jh8k.text: On your last evening you go back to Malay Street to pay Uncle Saldin for the tea.
15xye15jh8k.en: On your last evening you go back to Malay Street to pay Uncle Saldin for the tea.

10pkowwp20j.speaker: Uncle Saldin
10pkowwp20j.text: Orang Malaysia tu datang lagi semalam. Dua teh. Minum satu.
10pkowwp20j.en: Your Malaysian came again last night. Two teh. He drank one.

dir.say: [warm, old man, knowing] Orang Malaysia tu datang lagi semalam. [break] Dua teh. [break] Minum satu.

04nfz7og0rv.speaker: Narrator
04nfz7og0rv.text: He left a message, Saldin says. Galle Face Green, the bench by the old cannon, at sunset.
04nfz7og0rv.en: He left a message, Saldin says. Galle Face Green, the bench by the old cannon, at sunset.

0dibfkfzdy0.speaker: Narrator
0dibfkfzdy0.text: You wait until the kites come down. Nobody comes. On the bench, under a cup of tea gone cold, a paper kancil folded from a kottu receipt.
0dibfkfzdy0.en: You wait until the kites come down. Nobody comes. On the bench, under a cup of tea gone cold, a paper kancil folded from a kottu receipt.

dir.say: [quiet, melancholy] You wait until the kites come down. [break] Nobody comes. [long-break] [tender, aching] On the bench, under a cup of tea gone cold, a paper kancil folded from a kottu receipt.

1j6ugwtcst6.speaker: Narrator
1j6ugwtcst6.text: At midnight your phone rings. A Colombo number you have never seen.
1j6ugwtcst6.en: At midnight your phone rings. A Colombo number you have never seen.

dir.say: [long-break][low, warm, tired, close to the phone] Machan.

168za7mmba9.speaker: Narrator
168za7mmba9.text: One word. Behind it, the sea, and somewhere the clatter of kottu blades.
168za7mmba9.en: One word. Behind it, the sea, and somewhere the clatter of kottu blades.

1q5y7fg18k5.text: Not yet. Go home. Look at the lifts.
1q5y7fg18k5.en: Not yet. Go home. Look at the lifts.

dir.say: [quiet, urgent, gentle] Not yet. [break] Go home. [break] [low, meaningful] Look at the lifts.

01863adldlw.speaker: Narrator
01863adldlw.text: The line goes dead. Your hand has gone to the lighter in your pocket, and stays there.
01863adldlw.en: The line goes dead. Your hand has gone to the lighter in your pocket, and stays there.

10f9q2gq0uh.speaker: Narrator
10f9q2gq0uh.text: Before you board, Herath sends one more photograph: the top of the Port City email, the strip the shredder chewed. Sender: Office of the Chairman. Level 14, Menara Sinar, Kuala Lumpur.
10f9q2gq0uh.en: Before you board, Herath sends one more photograph: the top of the Port City email, the strip the shredder chewed. Sender: Office of the Chairman. Level 14, Menara Sinar, Kuala Lumpur.

dir.say: [low, measured, growing dread] Before you board, Herath sends one more photograph: the top of the Port City email, the strip the shredder chewed. [break] Sender: Office of the Chairman. [long-break] [cold, quiet] Level fourteen, Menara Sinar, Kuala Lumpur.

1p2iahm8vvh.speaker: Narrator
1p2iahm8vvh.text: The lifts in Menara Sinar go from 13 to 15.
1p2iahm8vvh.en: The lifts in Menara Sinar go from 13 to 15.

dir.say: [long-break][whispering, ominous] The lifts in Menara Sinar go from thirteen to fifteen.

0p9jxq5tamp.speaker: Narrator
0p9jxq5tamp.text: Ticket 0414 is still in the cloakroom ledger. One parcel, newspaper and string, left on Tuesday at 9:31 PM, three days paid in advance.
0p9jxq5tamp.en: Ticket 0414 is still in the cloakroom ledger. One parcel, newspaper and string, left on Tuesday at 9:31 PM, three days paid in advance.

dir.say: [measured, rising hope] Ticket oh four one four is still in the cloakroom ledger. [break] One parcel, newspaper and string, left on Tuesday at nine thirty-one, three days paid in advance.

205ms43wn1d.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
205ms43wn1d.text: Ninety rupees a day, and nobody looks inside. Every crook in Colombo knows it. So did one honest man.
205ms43wn1d.en: Ninety rupees a day, and nobody looks inside. Every crook in Colombo knows it. So did one honest man.

dir.say: [dry, wry] Ninety rupees a day, and nobody looks inside. Every crook in Colombo knows it. [break] [softer, respectful] So did one honest man.

0hx0h5u71bw.speaker: Narrator
0hx0h5u71bw.text: Inside, Yogi's carbon book. Sixty-one certificates in six years, and beside every one, in his small careful Tamil, what the stone was really worth.
0hx0h5u71bw.en: Inside, Yogi's carbon book. Sixty-one certificates in six years, and beside every one, in his small careful Tamil, what the stone was really worth.

0wyrjka34bu.speaker: Narrator
0wyrjka34bu.text: On the last page, in English, dated Tuesday: "Every valuation above was made on the instruction of S. Gunasekera, for the Office of the Chairman. I am sorry. P. Yogeswaran."
0wyrjka34bu.en: On the last page, in English, dated Tuesday: "Every valuation above was made on the instruction of S. Gunasekera, for the Office of the Chairman. I am sorry. P. Yogeswaran."

dir.say: [slow, grave] On the last page, in English, dated Tuesday: [break] "Every valuation above was made on the instruction of S. Gunasekera, for the Office of the Chairman. [long-break] [quiet, sorrowful] I am sorry. P. Yogeswaran."

1vjwagggndq.speaker: Narrator
1vjwagggndq.text: Clipped inside the back cover, a Malaysian customs release for three reefer units, Port Klang to Colombo, 2022. Officer: N. SALLEH.
1vjwagggndq.en: Clipped inside the back cover, a Malaysian customs release for three reefer units, Port Klang to Colombo, 2022. Officer: N. SALLEH.

dir.say: [low, ominous] Clipped inside the back cover, a Malaysian customs release for three reefer units, Port Klang to Colombo, 2022. [break] Officer: [emphasis] N. Salleh.

05p4bmruwlb.speaker: Narrator
05p4bmruwlb.text: CID take Uncle Saldin's counter apart board by board while he watches from the doorway with his hands behind his back. There is nothing under it but fifty years of dust.
05p4bmruwlb.en: CID take Uncle Saldin's counter apart board by board while he watches from the doorway with his hands behind his back. There is nothing under it but fifty years of dust.

dir.say: [flat, regretful] CID take Uncle Saldin's counter apart board by board while he watches from the doorway with his hands behind his back. [break] [quiet, ashamed] There is nothing under it but fifty years of dust.

09ob7hpihs9.speaker: Narrator
09ob7hpihs9.text: Navy divers spend two days in Beira Lake. They bring up a bicycle, a temple bell and a great deal of mud.
09ob7hpihs9.en: Navy divers spend two days in Beira Lake. They bring up a bicycle, a temple bell and a great deal of mud.

dir.say: [flat, weary] Navy divers spend two days in Beira Lake. [break] [dry, bitter] They bring up a bicycle, a temple bell and a great deal of mud.

0cx5lb8eage.speaker: Narrator
0cx5lb8eage.text: Nobody goes looking for the book.
0cx5lb8eage.en: Nobody goes looking for the book.

0hb70tnyrzw.speaker: Narrator
0hb70tnyrzw.text: Shehani Gunasekera is arrested at the Port City showroom at six in the morning, still in the grey dress from the charity dinner. Sinar Gems Lanka's lawyers arrive before the police jeep has left the car park.
0hb70tnyrzw.en: Shehani Gunasekera is arrested at the Port City showroom at six in the morning, still in the grey dress from the charity dinner. Sinar Gems Lanka's lawyers arrive before the police jeep has left the car park.

22xt8w2unon.text: Azman sends Farah a photograph from the cab of a crane at Westport, 4 AM on Thursday: a reefer unit going aboard a Singapore feeder. Serial RU-19.
22xt8w2unon.en: Azman sends Farah a photograph from the cab of a crane at Westport, 4 AM on Thursday: a reefer unit going aboard a Singapore feeder. Serial RU-19.

dir.say: [low, tense] Azman sends Farah a photograph from the cab of a crane at Westport, four in the morning on Thursday: a reefer unit going aboard a Singapore feeder. [break] [ominous] Serial R U nineteen.

2gdb4aai5pi.speaker: Narrator
2gdb4aai5pi.text: The export permit for RU-19 is stamped at Westport. Officer: N. SALLEH.
2gdb4aai5pi.en: The export permit for RU-19 is stamped at Westport. Officer: N. SALLEH.

dir.say: [flat, cold] The export permit for R U nineteen is stamped at Westport. [break] Officer: [emphasis] N. Salleh.

1w1f0gpw0ad.speaker: Narrator
1w1f0gpw0ad.text: The man who drove the reefer van down to the loading bay at three on Monday morning had a Sri Lankan seaman's pass, and four healing scratches on each forearm.
1w1f0gpw0ad.en: The man who drove the reefer van down to the loading bay at three on Monday morning had a Sri Lankan seaman's pass, and four healing scratches on each forearm.

dir.say: [low, ominous] The man who drove the reefer van down to the loading bay at three on Monday morning had a Sri Lankan seaman's pass, [break] [cold] and four healing scratches on each forearm.

120ptioibj6.speaker: Narrator
120ptioibj6.text: Farah sends one car and no radio. Mak Teh rolls up the warung shutter before anybody knocks, and points up the stairs without a word.
120ptioibj6.en: Farah sends one car and no radio. Mak Teh rolls up the warung shutter before anybody knocks, and points up the stairs without a word.

dir.say: [hushed, tense, dawn] Farah sends one car and no radio. [break] Mak Teh rolls up the warung shutter before anybody knocks, and points up the stairs without a word.

19l1fzxaevq.speaker: Narrator
19l1fzxaevq.text: He is at the window with two glasses of teh. He has drunk one. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.
19l1fzxaevq.en: He is at the window with two glasses of teh. He has drunk one. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

dir.say: [slow, overwhelmed, tender] He is at the window with two glasses of teh. [break] He has drunk one. [long-break] [voice thick] He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

2duubb8sas0.speaker: Daniel Raj
2duubb8sas0.text: You are late, machan. Five years late. I am not complaining.
2duubb8sas0.en: You are late, machan. Five years late. I am not complaining.

dir.say: [warm, tired, a crooked smile in the voice] You are late, machan. [break] Five years late. [break] [soft laugh] I am not complaining.

0c0c96oli88.speaker: Daniel Raj
0c0c96oli88.text: In 2021 they gave me a choice. Stay dead, and the detective lives. Come back, and the detective burns next. So I stayed dead.
0c0c96oli88.en: In 2021 they gave me a choice. Stay dead, and the detective lives. Come back, and the detective burns next. So I stayed dead.

dir.say: [low, quiet, confessing] In 2021 they gave me a choice. [break] Stay dead, and the detective lives. [break] Come back, and the detective burns next. [long-break] [aching, simple] So I stayed dead.

06nibxeog87.speaker: Daniel Raj
06nibxeog87.text: You gave the boy in Bay 3 his name back. Wei Jie. I watched them bury him as me, and I said nothing.
06nibxeog87.en: You gave the boy in Bay 3 his name back. Wei Jie. I watched them bury him as me, and I said nothing.

dir.say: [grieving, ashamed] You gave the boy in Bay three his name back. [break] Wei Jie. [break] [voice breaking] I watched them bury him as me, and I said nothing.
[long-break][close to tears, very quiet] மன்னிச்சிடு, [break] மச்சான்.

0kzjs91clpm.speaker: Narrator
0kzjs91clpm.text: You put the silver lighter on the sill between the glasses. He pushes it back. Its twin is in his pocket. He bought two in 2016, one each, for two people who never smoked.
0kzjs91clpm.en: You put the silver lighter on the sill between the glasses. He pushes it back. Its twin is in his pocket. He bought two in 2016, one each, for two people who never smoked.

dir.say: [tender, quiet] You put the silver lighter on the sill between the glasses. [break] He pushes it back. [break] Its twin is in his pocket. [long-break] [wistful, almost smiling] He bought two in 2016, one each, for two people who never smoked.

240o14w3rec.speaker: Narrator
240o14w3rec.text: Farah takes him to a house whose address she gives nobody, not even you. He goes down the wooden stairs with his hands in his pockets, like a man going to buy bread.
240o14w3rec.en: Farah takes him to a house whose address she gives nobody, not even you. He goes down the wooden stairs with his hands in his pockets, like a man going to buy bread.

dir.say: [quiet, relieved, bittersweet] Farah takes him to a house whose address she gives nobody, not even you. [break] [gentle] He goes down the wooden stairs with his hands in his pockets, like a man going to buy bread.

1aqxr8nxpq8.speaker: Narrator
1aqxr8nxpq8.text: Your office door is locked, the way you left it. The folder on your desk is not the way you left anything.
1aqxr8nxpq8.en: Your office door is locked, the way you left it. The folder on your desk is not the way you left anything.

dir.say: [tense, hushed] Your office door is locked, the way you left it. [break] [cold, slow] The folder on your desk is not the way you left anything.

1qqlu4921sa.speaker: Narrator
1qqlu4921sa.text: Grey archive board, a small embossed sun on the cover. On the tab, typed, your name. Opened 2016.
1qqlu4921sa.en: Grey archive board, a small embossed sun on the cover. On the tab, typed, your name. Opened 2016.

dir.say: [slow, dread] Grey archive board, a small embossed sun on the cover. [break] On the tab, typed, your name. [long-break] [whispering] Opened 2016.

02c36nue1x4.speaker: Narrator
02c36nue1x4.text: Inside, one photograph: you and Daniel at table 6 in Restoran Bala, taken from across Jalan Tun Sambanthan. August 2021, the week before the fire.
02c36nue1x4.en: Inside, one photograph: you and Daniel at table 6 in Restoran Bala, taken from across Jalan Tun Sambanthan. August 2021, the week before the fire.

dir.say: [low, shaken] Inside, one photograph: you and Daniel at table six in Restoran Bala, taken from across Jalan Tun Sambanthan. [long-break] [aching, quiet] August 2021, the week before the fire.

0kfwmjqqgei.speaker: Narrator
0kfwmjqqgei.text: And one typed list. H. Goh. Lim Chee Keong. P. Yogeswaran. Rashid Osman. Every name struck through by hand, in blue ink.
0kfwmjqqgei.en: And one typed list. H. Goh. Lim Chee Keong. P. Yogeswaran. Rashid Osman. Every name struck through by hand, in blue ink.

dir.say: [slow, grave, a roll call] And one typed list. [break] H. Goh. [break] Lim Chee Keong. [break] P. Yogeswaran. [break] Rashid Osman. [long-break] [cold] Every name struck through by hand, in blue ink.

0hsq723ts3c.speaker: Narrator
0hsq723ts3c.text: Under them, two names nobody has struck through yet. The first is Daniel's. The second is yours.
0hsq723ts3c.en: Under them, two names nobody has struck through yet. The first is Daniel's. The second is yours.

dir.say: [whispering, afraid] Under them, two names nobody has struck through yet. [break] The first is Daniel's. [long-break] [very quiet] The second is yours.

0x5ndmvtmz8.speaker: Narrator
0x5ndmvtmz8.text: Across the city, on Jalan Ampang, one storey of black glass that Bomba sealed this morning has a light on in it.
0x5ndmvtmz8.en: Across the city, on Jalan Ampang, one storey of black glass that Bomba sealed this morning has a light on in it.

dir.say: [long-break][hushed, ominous, slow] Across the city, on Jalan Ampang, one storey of black glass that Bomba sealed this morning [break] has a light on in it.

0ks1y6c6s9p.speaker: Narrator
0ks1y6c6s9p.text: Farah's team searches your office while Bala Anne watches from the stairs with a ladle in his hand. They find your kettle, your files, and nobody.
0ks1y6c6s9p.en: Farah's team searches your office while Bala Anne watches from the stairs with a ladle in his hand. They find your kettle, your files, and nobody.

dir.say: [flat, rueful] Farah's team searches your office while Bala Anne watches from the stairs with a ladle in his hand. [break] [quiet, hollow] They find your kettle, your files, and nobody.

22h0k3dx6js.speaker: Narrator
22h0k3dx6js.text: By the time anybody thinks of Kampung Baru it is evening. Mak Teh is sitting on the warung steps. At noon, she says, two men in polo shirts with a little sun on the pocket went up, and came down with a third man between them. A van was waiting at the end of the Saloma bridge.
22h0k3dx6js.en: By the time anybody thinks of Kampung Baru it is evening. Mak Teh is sitting on the warung steps. At noon, she says, two men in polo shirts with a little sun on the pocket went up, and came down with a third man between them. A van was waiting at the end of the Saloma bridge.

dir.say: [heavy, slow] By the time anybody thinks of Kampung Baru it is evening. Mak Teh is sitting on the warung steps. [break] [low, dread] At noon, she says, two men in polo shirts with a little sun on the pocket went up, and came down with a third man between them. [break] [quiet, sick] A van was waiting at the end of the Saloma bridge.

0iyvlzdtam6.speaker: Mak Teh
0iyvlzdtam6.text: Dia suruh saya jangan menangis. Saya menangis juga.
0iyvlzdtam6.en: He told me not to cry. I cried anyway.

dir.say: [old woman, crying softly] Dia suruh saya jangan menangis. [break] [sobbing] Saya menangis juga.

298imfraqhd.speaker: Narrator
298imfraqhd.text: Upstairs, a chair on its side, two glasses of teh across the floorboards, and in the tea a silver flip-top lighter, the twin of the one in your pocket. Engraved inside the lid: D.R.
298imfraqhd.en: Upstairs, a chair on its side, two glasses of teh across the floorboards, and in the tea a silver flip-top lighter, the twin of the one in your pocket. Engraved inside the lid: D.R.

dir.say: [hushed, stricken] Upstairs, a chair on its side, two glasses of teh across the floorboards, [break] and in the tea a silver flip-top lighter, the twin of the one in your pocket. [long-break] [whispering] Engraved inside the lid: D. R.

04ppanp04tb.speaker: Narrator
04ppanp04tb.text: The warrant in his name stays open. Whether he ran or was taken, he is a wanted man now, and nobody looks hard for a wanted man who has disappeared.
04ppanp04tb.en: The warrant in his name stays open. Whether he ran or was taken, he is a wanted man now, and nobody looks hard for a wanted man who has disappeared.

dir.say: [bitter, low] The warrant in his name stays open. [break] Whether he ran or was taken, he is a wanted man now, [break] [quiet, guilty] and nobody looks hard for a wanted man who has disappeared.

1uo4kurcjqo.speaker: Narrator
1uo4kurcjqo.text: Farah's people walk the length of the morning flight to Colombo at KLIA. Seat 14A is empty. It was booked from a Sinar travel account at four on Monday morning.
1uo4kurcjqo.en: Farah's people walk the length of the morning flight to Colombo at KLIA. Seat 14A is empty. It was booked from a Sinar travel account at four on Monday morning.

dir.say: [tense, flat] Farah's people walk the length of the morning flight to Colombo at K L I A. [break] Seat fourteen A is empty. [break] [cold, realizing] It was booked from a Sinar travel account at four on Monday morning.

1ap0pxa5w3z.speaker: Narrator
1ap0pxa5w3z.text: Bomba opens the fourteenth floor for Farah a second time. There is nobody on it but the two of you, and a chair facing the window.
1ap0pxa5w3z.en: Bomba opens the fourteenth floor for Farah a second time. There is nobody on it but the two of you, and a chair facing the window.

dir.say: [flat, hollow] Bomba opens the fourteenth floor for Farah a second time. [break] [quiet, uneasy] There is nobody on it but the two of you, and a chair facing the window.

0ilwb3o75xm.speaker: Narrator
0ilwb3o75xm.text: Farah does not send anybody anywhere.
0ilwb3o75xm.en: Farah does not send anybody anywhere.

0g8vsq1rvha.speaker: Narrator
0g8vsq1rvha.text: A warrant for murder goes out in the name of K. Rajan. Under it, in pencil, where only she will see it, Farah writes the other name.
0g8vsq1rvha.en: A warrant for murder goes out in the name of K. Rajan. Under it, in pencil, where only she will see it, Farah writes the other name.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] A warrant for murder goes out in the name of K. Rajan. [long-break] [quiet, aching] Under it, in pencil, where only she will see it, Farah writes the other name.

1hps9upsofg.speaker: Nurul Ain
1hps9upsofg.text: They say it was the man with the paper animals. Abah told me to help him. I do not know which one of them was lying to me.
1hps9upsofg.en: They say it was the man with the paper animals. Abah told me to help him. I do not know which one of them was lying to me.

dir.say: [hurt, confused] They say it was the man with the paper animals. [break] Abah told me to help him. [break] [bitter, breaking] I do not know which one of them was lying to me.

25ii5q3yqi1.speaker: Narrator
25ii5q3yqi1.text: Farah sends four cars, because the warrant says murder. Mak Teh stands in the warung doorway with her hand over her mouth.
25ii5q3yqi1.en: Farah sends four cars, because the warrant says murder. Mak Teh stands in the warung doorway with her hand over her mouth.

dir.say: [heavy, clipped] Farah sends four cars, because the warrant says murder. [break] [sorrowful] Mak Teh stands in the warung doorway with her hand over her mouth.

1cmmeeggu7b.speaker: Narrator
1cmmeeggu7b.text: He comes down the wooden steps with his hands held out in front of him before anybody asks. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.
1cmmeeggu7b.en: He comes down the wooden steps with his hands held out in front of him before anybody asks. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

dir.say: [slow, stricken] He comes down the wooden steps with his hands held out in front of him before anybody asks. [long-break] [voice thick] He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

17c5mco4k83.speaker: Daniel Raj
17c5mco4k83.text: Machan. You did right, with what they gave you.
17c5mco4k83.en: Machan. You did right, with what they gave you.

dir.say: [calm, gentle, forgiving] Machan. [break] You did right, with what they gave you.

1l13j6cbvb9.speaker: Narrator
1l13j6cbvb9.text: He is remanded at Sungai Buloh, in a block where Sinar's lawyers already have three clients.
1l13j6cbvb9.en: He is remanded at Sungai Buloh, in a block where Sinar's lawyers already have three clients.

dir.say: [flat, low, dread] He is remanded at Sungai Buloh, [break] in a block where Sinar's lawyers already have three clients.

14wtmlb7k93.speaker: Narrator
14wtmlb7k93.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar signs the remand order himself.
14wtmlb7k93.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar signs the remand order himself.

23efd1082au.speaker: Narrator
23efd1082au.text: Zulkifli Hamid is arrested in the control room on B1, in front of his own monitors. He takes the earpiece out himself, coils the wire, and puts it in Farah's hand. "You still drop your left shoulder when you shoot," he tells her.
23efd1082au.en: Zulkifli Hamid is arrested in the control room on B1, in front of his own monitors. He takes the earpiece out himself, coils the wire, and puts it in Farah's hand. "You still drop your left shoulder when you shoot," he tells her.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Zulkifli Hamid is arrested in the control room on B one, in front of his own monitors. [break] [slower, sad] He takes the earpiece out himself, coils the wire, and puts it in Farah's hand. [break] [quiet, bitter] "You still drop your left shoulder when you shoot," he tells her.

1pecmomnc1t.speaker: Narrator
1pecmomnc1t.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman in front of his own officers. The murder charge will not last the week. The envelope in his glovebox, RM 8,000 in fifties, will.
1pecmomnc1t.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman in front of his own officers. The murder charge will not last the week. The envelope in his glovebox, RM 8,000 in fifties, will.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman in front of his own officers. [break] The murder charge will not last the week. [break] [dry, pointed] The envelope in his glovebox, eight thousand ringgit in fifties, will.

0ziizqyzuk2.speaker: Nurul Ain
0ziizqyzuk2.text: You arrested a superintendent. My editor cleared the whole front page for it. Abah would have read it twice and asked who was still upstairs.
0ziizqyzuk2.en: You arrested a superintendent. My editor cleared the whole front page for it. Abah would have read it twice and asked who was still upstairs.

dir.say: [dry, tired, sceptical] You arrested a superintendent. My editor cleared the whole front page for it. [break] [sad, knowing] Abah would have read it twice and asked who was still upstairs.

0tj6oku1s49.speaker: Narrator
0tj6oku1s49.text: Vivian Chua is arrested at her house in Bukit Tunku at five in the morning. She is dressed, with her handbag on her knee, as if she has been waiting for a car. She asks for one telephone call, and does not make it.
0tj6oku1s49.en: Vivian Chua is arrested at her house in Bukit Tunku at five in the morning. She is dressed, with her handbag on her knee, as if she has been waiting for a car. She asks for one telephone call, and does not make it.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Vivian Chua is arrested at her house in Bukit Tunku at five in the morning. [break] [uneasy] She is dressed, with her handbag on her knee, as if she has been waiting for a car. [break] [quiet, cold] She asks for one telephone call, and does not make it.

149rdips4t8.speaker: Nurul Ain
149rdips4t8.text: He did not jump. He was pushed while he was trying to undo something. I can write that now. I can write both of those.
149rdips4t8.en: He did not jump. He was pushed while he was trying to undo something. I can write that now. I can write both of those.

dir.say: [tearful, steadying] He did not jump. [break] He was pushed while he was trying to undo something. [break] [quiet, fierce, grateful] I can write that now. I can write both of those.
